place-of-supply-bug.title: Place of supply defaults to the seller's state

words-from-taxable-value-bug.title: Amount in words uses the taxable value, not the grand total
words-from-taxable-value-bug.impact: The legally stated amount in words is short by the whole tax

b2c-igst-bug.title: IGST only for registered (B2B) buyers
b2c-igst-bug.impact: Out-of-state consumers get CGST + SGST instead of IGST

us-tax-on-subtotal-bug.title: Sales tax charged on the whole subtotal
us-tax-on-subtotal-bug.impact: Non-taxable services get taxed ($274.31 instead of $76.31)

resale-certificate-bug.title: Resale certificates only honoured for out-of-state customers
resale-certificate-bug.impact: An in-state reseller with a valid certificate is charged sales tax
